notes.title: Insomnis comes to terrify Xbox and Epic Games gamers!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34106575/8e59597ff6201031872d8b1afcd3231b5fd563ac.jpg

Insomnis comes to terrify Xbox and Epic Games gamers!

Insomnis has been making gamers around the world's hair stand on end for some time now. Translated into 15 languages, the horror video game developed by Path Games has garnered critical and sales success among PlayStation, Nintendo Switch and PC users. Users of Xbox and Epic Games are in luck because Insomnis is now available on Xbox in digital format from Meridiem Games, and will also be available on Epic Games.

[previewyoutube=CAWWW-ou4PA;full][/previewyoutube]

Insomnis is a horror video game based on puzzle solving, set in a changing, maddening scenario. It will lead you to get into the skin of Jon Castevet, a man who thinks he is lucky because he has just inherited a large mansion. What Jon ignores is that the old Castevet's house hides a endless number of secrets, which will throw him into a spiral of horror. An atmospheric horror genre story that will not leave you indifferent.
 
Throughout the plot the player will have to explore a mansion, like someone immersed in a nightmare, and will become familiar with a very fluid gameplay, a progressive learning that even makes tutorials unnecessary, while learning to use his wits to solve all the riddles, analog and digital, connected to each other... in case he does not lose his sanity.

Featured content: 

 Atmospheric Horror: As you enter the Castevet's abode, the scenery will change and your worst nightmares will come to life. Escape from your past before it's too late!
 Analog and digital puzzles: Solve numerous types of convoluted, interconnected puzzles as you struggle to maintain your sanity.
 Story focused on exploration: Immerse yourself in a morally ambiguous narrative, where nothing is as it seems. Dark secrets await you... Explore your grandfather's abandoned abode in search of answers!
 Multiple endings: Decide with caution, your choices will decide the fate of the characters.

notes.title: Insomnis: Enhanced Edition Physical Release PS5
notes.content:
Hello there!

We're very excited to announce the physical edition release of Insomnis for PS5. Orders here: https://bit.ly/InsomnisOrders

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34106575/26e582f013f7069d96304b48c462e44373865e41.png

The physical edition includes:

 Base Game
 Special Cover
 Artbook
 Set of cards


Joe Castevet's terrifying story comes to PS5 with improved textures, 4k resolution, haptic vibration and atmospheric sound from DualSense 3D audio, dynamic shadow enhancements and faster load times thanks to the next-gen console engine.

Happy horror days
